s.note: Egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese, and beetroot and dill finger sandwiches
s.how: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise and cress. Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon. Use the white bread to make cucumber and cream cheese, egg, and beetroot, cream cheese and dill sandwiches. Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers. Lay on a tiered stand.

s.note: Lemon chive crab mayo and cucumber on soft white bread, crusts off
s.how: Mix 250g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, chopped chives and pepper. Butter 8 slices soft white bread with 30g butter. Spread the crab over 4 slices, lay thin slices of 1 Lebanese cucumber on top and close with the remaining bread. Press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

m.note: Creamy bright green soup with leek, potato and watercress
m.how: Sweat 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced potatoes in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 2 bunches watercress for 1 minute, then blitz until bright green. Finish with 100ml cream.

w.note: Dense dark chocolate cake with a chocolate cream glaze
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar and fold in the chocolate, 100g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream. Serve thin slices.

d.note: English breakfast tea sweetened with honey and blended peach, over ice
d.how: Steep 4 English breakfast tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and stir in 3 tbsp honey. Cool. Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 200ml cold water and strain into the tea. Chill 2 hours. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.
